svg.title: The exact pullback and the full parameter connection
svg.desc: The principal-bundle square sends p in P H to a p in L, and x in X to r H of x in D. Its vertical arrows are bundle projections. D has dimension 49, its base M has dimension 24 and its fibre G over K has dimension 25. The associated rank 24 bundle E D pulls back to W H and is the pullback of T M. The total parameter space Y has dimension 73. The lower panel lists the full connection and its parameter, mixed, spatial and zero time curvature components.

g.text: A nontrivial reduction with an explicit higher carrier
K = ρ(Sp(1)) ⊂ G = Spin(8) ⊂ L = F₄. Every arrow below is the specified map.
P_H ≅ r_H*(L → D); π_D r_H(x) = G.
The square is a pullback. Both vertical arrows are projections.
The connection on Y × ℝ¹˒³ includes every parameter direction
𝔅 = b_A dyᴬ + cᵢ dxⁱ, 𝔅₀ = 0, cᵢ = φ(Cᵢ).
Outside the spatial support: mixed and spatial terms vanish; parameter curvature remains.
Proofs: Lesson 3, (3.27)–(3.43) and (3.44)–(3.50). Bundle dimensions are exact.
This diagram describes the bundle and connection; it makes no continuum spectral assertion.
